observations: The page number «( 21 )» stands at the head of the page, centred. The page has no footnotes and no signature.

L01-L13: ten seconds by five minutes concluded (p. 20, frame 026, L24-L33): the multiplication by sixty and the division lower the result by one place, named «secunda» (see the critical note). The proof of division: what the division gives, multiplied by the divisor, returns the number divided: fifty by ten, five, and five by ten, fifty; the two of the example by five minutes gives ten seconds, «et hec est probatio diuisionis». L13-L20: ten minutes by five thirds: ten minutes are 36000 thirds, which divided by five thirds give 7200 whole degrees; the proof: 7200 degrees by five thirds, 36000 thirds, divided by sixty, 600 seconds, and by sixty again, ten minutes.

L21-L33: how to set out a whole number with its fractions: the whole number in the highest place, the minutes under it, the seconds under the minutes, the thirds under the seconds, and so on. The example: twelve degrees, thirty minutes, forty-six seconds («.xl. quoque .vi.») and fifty fourths: twelve; under it thirty in the place of the minutes; under the thirty «xlv.», forty-five, in the place of the seconds (see the critical note); circles in the place of the thirds, which are lacking; fifty in the place of the fourths. L33 «et hec est figura eorum.»: the figure is not printed.

Numerals: L05, L08 and L27 «.l.», fifty; L29 «xlv.» without the opening point. L15 «et» before «erunt», L23 «sunt» and L33 «et» are set with spaced letters (6 to 7 px between the letters); transcribed as words.

Spaces at punctuation (rule of tools/punct.py: after a mark, a space where the gap is at least 12 px or two thirds of the median word space of the line; before a mark, where it is at least 10 px): with a space before the mark, L05 «est :» (21 px), L19 «.lx. ,» (10 px), L21 «fractiones ,» (13 px), L22 «differentia :» (22 px), L25 «secundis ,» (18 px) and L29 «minutorum ;» (18 px); without a space after the mark, L02 «numerum,quod» (7 px, the median word space of the line 15 px) and L14 «.v.tercia» (7 px, median 18 px). L10 «secunda:», the colon 9 px from the word, and L25 «differentiis.», the point 9 px from the word, are set close. L05 «.x. exibunt» (13 px, median 19.5 px), L07 «diuiso, idest» (12 px) and L14 «tercia, uerte» (12 px) have a space. Specks after the commas of L10 «uni,» and L11 «da,» and the pencil above the colon of L05 «est :» shorten the measured gaps; the gaps to the next word are 17, 18 and 28 px.

L01: «secunda:» is a colon; below the lower dot a light trace (darkest pixel 101) runs down to the left, not a printed tail. The semicolons of L15, L19, L24, L29 and L33 have printed tails (darkest pixel 42 to 68). L26: a light mark above the point of «est.» (darkest pixel 113) is not transcribed.
copy_matter: A reader's notes in pencil: «quod» beside the page number at the head of the page; L01, «et» underlined, «quare» underlined with a hooked stroke, and «quia» with the same stroke in the right margin; «quia» written between L04 and L05 above «quare» (L05), which is underlined; L10, «et» underlined and «quod» in the right margin; L16, a curved line under «gradus, et hoc est quod debetur uni.» ending in a bracket after «uni.», and a bracket before «Cumque» (L17); L31, «quare» underlined and «quia» in the right margin; L33, «hec» underlined and «hoc» in the right margin. Not part of the edition.

critical_notes.evidence: the quotient of ten seconds by five minutes is two minutes (p. 20, L24-L33, and the critical note there): one multiplication by sixty and a division lower the result by one place from the units, to the minutes; the proof (L09-L12) multiplies the quotient by five minutes and gets ten seconds, which holds for two minutes, two seconds by five minutes being ten thirds
critical_notes.impact: the quotient is named seconds for minutes in the conclusion and in the proof; the figures are right

critical_notes.proposed: the same number of seconds in both places, 46 or 45
critical_notes.evidence: the number to be set out has forty-six seconds, «.xl. quoque .vi. secunda» (L27), and the seconds set out under the thirty minutes are «xlv.», forty-five (L29); the figure, which would decide, is not printed
critical_notes.impact: the example states 46 seconds and sets out 45
